question: List top 5 customers by total delivered order spend.
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 5
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 5

question: Count products per category.
sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY product_count DESC, category ASC
gold_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY product_count DESC, category ASC LIMIT 50

question: CTE: customers with more than 1 order.
sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.name, oc.cnt FROM customers c JOIN order_counts oc ON c.id = oc.customer_id WHERE oc.cnt > 1 ORDER BY oc.cnt DESC, c.name ASC
gold_sql: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT c.name, oc.cnt FROM customers c JOIN order_counts oc ON c.id = oc.customer_id WHERE oc.cnt > 1 ORDER BY oc.cnt DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT 50

question: Window function: rank products by price within each category.
sql: SELECT name, category, price, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price DESC, name ASC) AS price_rank FROM products ORDER BY category ASC, price_rank ASC
gold_sql: SELECT name, category, price, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price DESC, name ASC) AS price_rank FROM products ORDER BY category ASC, price_rank ASC LIMIT 50

question: Window function: running revenue over order dates.
sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total, SUM(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) OVER (ORDER BY o.order_date ASC, o.id ASC) AS running_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.id, o.order_date ORDER BY o.order_date ASC, o.id ASC
gold_sql: SELECT o.id, o.order_date, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total, SUM(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price)) OVER (ORDER BY o.order_date ASC, o.id ASC) AS running_revenue FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY o.id, o.order_date ORDER BY o.order_date ASC, o.id ASC LIMIT 50

question: NULL handling: customers with COALESCE on city and left-joined order count.
sql: SELECT c.name, COALESCE(c.city, 'Unknown') AS city, COUNT(o.id) AS order_cnt FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name, c.city ORDER BY c.name ASC
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COALESCE(c.city, 'Unknown') AS city, COUNT(o.id) AS order_cnt FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.name, c.city ORDER BY c.name ASC LIMIT 50

question: Date aggregation: monthly order counts.
sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS orders_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month ASC
gold_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_date) AS order_month, COUNT(*) AS orders_count FROM orders GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month ASC LIMIT 50

question: Multi-table join: revenue by product category.
sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.category ASC
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS revenue FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC, p.category ASC LIMIT 50

question: HAVING filter: customers with total spend above 5000.
sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > 5000 ORDER BY total_spend DESC, c.name ASC
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id GROUP BY c.name HAVING SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) > 5000 ORDER BY total_spend DESC, c.name ASC LIMIT 50

question: CASE WHEN bucket: classify products into budget/mid/premium.
sql: SELECT name, CASE WHEN price < 1000 THEN 'budget' WHEN price < 5000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'premium' END AS tier FROM products ORDER BY id ASC
gold_sql: SELECT name, CASE WHEN price < 1000 THEN 'budget' WHEN price < 5000 THEN 'mid' ELSE 'premium' END AS tier FROM products ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 50

question: Distinct countries of customers.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT country FROM customers WHERE country IS NOT NULL ORDER BY country ASC

question: Subquery: products ordered in quantity greater than 1.
sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE id IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM order_items WHERE quantity > 1) ORDER BY name ASC
gold_sql: SELECT name FROM products WHERE id IN (SELECT DISTINCT product_id FROM order_items WHERE quantity > 1) ORDER BY name ASC LIMIT 50

question: Leading block comment on valid SELECT.

question: Customers from India with order count.
sql: SELECT c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS orders_cnt FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'India' GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY c.name ASC

question: Average order value across delivered orders.
sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) AS avg_delivered_value FROM (SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY o.id) sub
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(order_total), 2) AS avg_delivered_value FROM (SELECT o.id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS order_total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY o.id) sub LIMIT 50

question: ROW_NUMBER top product per category.
sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT name, category, price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price DESC, name ASC) AS rn FROM products) SELECT category, name, price FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY category ASC
gold_sql: WITH ranked AS (SELECT name, category, price, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY price DESC, name ASC) AS rn FROM products) SELECT category, name, price FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY category ASC LIMIT 50
